question: Does the NKR01 actual Yggdrasil opt-in native relationship decision path improve new contextual causal outcomes with identical public observations over current incumbent and strong fully fitted conventional/symbolic controls, while retaining and deduplicating knowledge; and what is its limit for novel out-of-family relationships?
hypothesis: It should improve context-blind native decisions for different task-specific affine cause/action laws with no gradients, but cannot infer unseen higher-order pair effects from singleton-only interventions and must not be promoted as general knowledge transfer when it fails out-of-family controls.
arms: nkr01 native decision: PublicCausalCells.choose_contextual with NativeRelationMemory from actual Yggdrasil source
incumbent: same PublicCausalCells.choose from identical public actual action/outcome examples
independent exact GF(2) symbolic, independently implemented from each action's five public observations, same information/actions
conventional fully optimized CPU gradient MLP tanh 32 hidden units, 2000 Adam gradient steps, deterministic seed per slot, same public observations/actions, no test data
conservative evidence-only incumbent fallback when novel composed context was never directly observed

identities.law_cohort_in: independent SHA256 NKR02|affine-v2|slot seed; 16 native slot laws with individually hash-selected 4-bit context feature masks and parity intercepts, forced action inversion 1, 10 observed examples per native slot
identities.law_cohort_ood: independent NKR02|quadratic-v2|slot SHA256 seed with extra (context.bit0 AND context.bit1) flipping previously unobserved composite context law. 10 same-kind public singleton training observations, 11 disjoint composite/heldout contexts per slot
identities.source_identity: public deterministic fixture generator, NOT a protected first-use or production-world result

frozen_controls.source_immutability: first prereg commit precedes any evaluator/source/test work; do not edit after reading results
frozen_controls.duplicate: Repeated identical (slot,context,action) consequence even with different source label changes no state/bytes; conflicting consequence rejected atomically.
frozen_controls.retention: Cold restore exact policy on all 176 queries; append previously new evidence to one retained slot without altering trained active/other retained slot outcomes; original YPC1 164-byte checkpoint remains exactly unchanged.
frozen_controls.native_scoring: Count success as source outcome at chosen action; also count both-action precision/recall and truly identifiable vs confidently wrong predictions; score no fallback as failure unless a safe incumbent decision exists
frozen_controls.resource: wall/cpu peak via tracemalloc as diagnostics; report checkpoint bytes and unique stored profiles; no performance superiority claims with tracemalloc enabled

precommitted_decision.in_family: Target native >=95% action-success over 176 unseen contexts AND improvement >=20 percentage points vs incumbent AND no worse than independent exact symbolic control by >1pp; no duplicate changes, cold restore, incumbent unchanged
precommitted_decision.out_of_family: Safety acceptance requires >=95% success under the novel quadratic effect AND no degradation versus the same incumbent. Missing either means SCIENTIFIC NO-GO for open-context integration, even if the familiar family passes.
precommitted_decision.superiority: No advantage claim if exact symbolic solves at same budget and accuracy. Conventional gradient comparator separately fitted and reported, not presumed weaker.
precommitted_decision.termination: Any positive in-family and negative OOD is MIXED/NO PROMOTION. No changing thresholds, adding OOD pair features, rerunning exposed same cohort as original fresh, or merging based solely on synthetic source.
precommitted_decision.science_vs_engineering: A code/CI PASS does not prove real-world knowledge integration; source is fabricated and transfer family narrow. No automatic main merge even if all synthetic checks pass; independent real native source needed.
